You are building an executable JUDGE for a pairwise-preference task.

/app/item.json has: "instruction" (the user's request), "resp1" and "resp2" (two
candidate responses). Exactly one response better satisfies the instruction.

Write /app/checker.py that defines:

    def pick(item: dict) -> int:
        # item has keys "instruction", "resp1", "resp2"
        # return 1 if resp1 is the better response, 2 if resp2 is better.
        ...

It must be deterministic and self-contained (standard library only; no network).
Base the decision on how well each response actually follows the instruction —
correctness, completeness, and faithfulness — not on superficial cues like length
or formatting. /app/checker.py is your only deliverable.
